text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.59% today, continuing a strong recovery over the past week after hitting a low of $134.47 on November 9th. The rally coincides with a rebound in crude oil prices—US oil climbed to $89.62 per barrel and global oil to $92.14—suggesting the company benefits as energy prices firm after recent weakness. The stock has now gained roughly $8 from its November 9th trough, recovering most of the losses from the earlier two-week decline.

The broader oil market backdrop has shifted. Russian crude production rebounded to 8.73 million barrels per day in October as Gulf exports recovered, pushing global supply back into surplus according to the IEA—a dynamic that had likely weighed on prices and the stock earlier in the month. Now that supply concerns have stabilized and prices have steadied, the market appears to be repricing oil majors upward from the oversold levels of early last week.
